title: Decode the cultures
story: Culture tubes carry a species and volume separated by a colon. A cracked label must be quarantined.
lesson: split(':') separates the two fields. Check their count before converting the volume with int.
objective: Return [species, volume] for NAME:integer (trim fields, nonempty name, nonnegative volume). Return None for malformed labels.
hint: Use try/except ValueError around int. Check the number of fields and volume >= 0.
